title: More of a robotic sweeper than a vaccum
text:
More of a robotic sweeper than a vaccum. TL/DR (Conclusion): this unit really only does the job of eliminating routine light sweeping of floors. You will still need to get into corners with a broom. The dust bin needs emptying (very) frequently and the roller becomes clogged with lint quickly due to it's small diameter and width. The low height is great as it fits under most furniture. Daily automated program does not work properly. 2.5 stars. REALLY wish it had a smartphone app.

The price I paid, $109, was a great deal. The unit does a decent job of basic sweeping of floors on demand. It is capable of remembering obstacles, even though it is not really supposed to be able to map your home. If a new obstacle appears in its path, it will tap it, reverse, work it's way around it, and remember it is there for the duration of the cycle. It does seem to remember hard boundaries (walls, furniture), even though mapping is not supposed to be one of its features. I also purchased the magnetic boundary strip to keep it out of a specific area, and this works perfectly.

It does a decent job sweeping up dust and light particles, although it cannot quite reach all the way into corners with the brushes. The suction is not very strong unless you use the Max setting, but this depletes the battery rapidly. You will need to use the Max setting for some larger particles. The sweeping roller is not very long or wide and becomes clogged up with lint very easily, requiring a good cleaning about every third run or so. The dust bin is tiny, and requires emptying after every use in my small space, and likely several times if used in a larger area. The unit itself is gloss black on top and gets very dusty every time it is used, requiring frequent thorough dusting/cleaning. I did not bother purchasing the mop accessory, because online video reviews point out it is not really mopping, just the equivalent of dragging a wet cloth around on the floor, and is quite useless in this respect.

The primary reason I selected this model were the positive video reviews elsewhere conducted by an independent third party which brutally tests all robotic vacuums and records all tests on video. This model is the same mechanically as another top-selling robot which is simply private-labeled. This is apparently the OEM, and is significantly cheaper as a result.

By far the best feature is the low height/profile. This is the slimmest robotic vacuum I have ever seen. It is only 7.2cm tall! It can easily go under sofas, my media center, chairs, and most furniture with a wide enough opening for it to enter. It is also quite good at getting itself out of tight "traps" (i.e. behind furniture or under a couch with stuff there), but will stop if it becomes tangled or stuck, issuing a loud beep in the process. This is one reason I wish it had a smart phone app so it could alert you when it gets stuck.

What doesn't work:
1) The automation aspect does not function properly. I tried setting it up to go every day at the same time, and it did it for two days, then stopped without explanation. I tried again, and could not get it to hold the program. Then about 8 months later, following a brief power outage at home, it started automatically cleaning every day at the same time again, as though it had remembered the program or the feature had been re-enabled, but the time was not as previously set. When I tried to change the time, it seemed to save it, but it has failed to clean automatically on any day since. If I want it to run, I just grab the remote and hit "auto". Not such a big deal, really, but I wish it worked.

2) It cannot navigate any threshold with a height greater than about 3/8". This means in my house it cannot move from the hardwood in the living areas to carpet in bedrooms, etc. This is very frustrating. I have to give it a push if I want it to try to vacuum the carpet on the other side of the threshold. Which leads to number 3...

3) This unit is about 75% useless for vacuuming carpet. It will pick up surface debris, but that's it. If you want a proper vacuuming, you need to use a MUCH stronger vacuum. Even on Max suction mode, this does not do a deep cleaning (not even close), and the rotating brush becomes clogged with fibers very quickly due it's small diameter.

Conclusion: this unit really only does the job of eliminating routine light daily sweeping of floors. You will still need to get into corners with a broom. The dust bin needs emptying (very) frequently and the roller becomes clogged with lint quickly due to it's small diameter and width. The low height is great as it fits under most furniture. Daily automated program does not work properly.

Recommended? Yes, if it is on sale for about $100 (it frequently is). If I had paid $200, I would have been disappointed and may have returned it. Just keep your expectations realistic: this will sweep your hard floors and suck up the particles. That's it. If you have a lot of carpet, I would not recommend this unit.

product_metadata.title: Coredy Robot Vacuum Cleaner, Fully Upgraded, Boundary Strip Supported, 360° Smart Sensor Protection, Strong Max Suction, Super Quiet, Self-Charge Robotic Vacuum, Cleans Pet Fur, Hard Floor
features: 3-in-1 Sweep Vacuum Mop Robotic Vacuum Cleaner: Robot is a 7.2cm super thin robot vacuum cleaner, eliminate dirt from under beds, sofa and hard to reach areas with zero effort. Include 3-point cleaning system and dual edge-brushes, works on hard floors and carpets to clean the dust and pet hair. Conveniently clean, schedule and customize cleaning preferences from remote control. Sleek, anti-scratch tempered glass top cover design complements your home decor.

Wet-Dry Mopping Function: Robot floor cleaner robot supports wet-dry mopping function, vacuum multi-surfaces, dry sweep hardwood floors or wet-dry mop hard surface floors as you need, providing a comprehensive cleaning performance (Water tank and cleaning mop cloth sold separately). Anti-collision prevents unnecessary crashes, anti-drop intelligent sensor technology avoids to fall.

5 Efficient Cleaning Modes: Robot smart vacuum cleaner adopts 5 selective cleaning modes which includes Spot Cleaning, Edge Cleaning, Max Vacuuming Cleaning, Single Room Cleaning and Manual Cleaning to easily clean your place. Enjoy your time and leave this wireless vacuum to take care of your home. Engineered with dual-hall sensors can detect boundary strips to keep robot in the rooms you want to clean (Boundary strips sold separately).

Auto Charging: Robot supports up to 120 minutes of constant cleaning, which is suitable for all household or public places cleaning. With self-charging technology, the robot vacuum could seek the charging base automatically after finishing its work or on low power, make sure that it's always ready to clean. Easily increase the suction power from max suction to stable between different modes, but extremely quiet under 60dB.

What You Get: An robot vacuum cleaner, plus completely range of robot vacuum accessories: 4x side brushes, 1x extra set of filter, 1x main brush, 1x remote control, 1x cleaning brush, 1x charging dock, 1x power adapter, 1x welcome guide and user manual. Support floor mopping cleaning function and Boundaries Stripes (Sold Separately).
description: Coredy fully upgraded R500+ robot vacuum cleaner, keep your home spotless without needing to lift a finger, sleek, stylish design complements your home decoration.
Max vacuuming mode increases vacuum power in order to provide a deeper clean whenever you need.
Auto-adjust cleaning head and two large wheels moves effortlessly from hard floor to carpets to get the mess.
Equipped with dual-hall sensors to detect boundary strips to keep your robot only clean the home and areas you want.
Upgraded highly sensitive anti-collision technology for evading obstacles, and drop-sensing tech to avoid falls.
The R500+ comes with dual-layer filter and one high-performance net filter that easily filter out a range of dust and allergy including particles, ideal for home with pets.
Powered by 2600mAh Li-ion battery, the Coredy robotic vacuum cleans for up to 120 min per charge, meaning all of the rooms in your home can be cleaned from a single charge.
At Coredy, we back our products with a 12-month warranty and provide friendly, easy-to-reach toll free call technical support.

To keep your robotic vacuum cleaners at optimal performance, please regularly clean the R500+ robotic vacuums, and always keep vacuum robot charged on the home base when not in use. Please see the user manual for detail instructions on how to properly clean your R500+ vacuum cleaner. The R500+ smart vacuum comes with complimentary cleaning tools.
